'''WhiteCon 2001''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 2001. Lumsten won it. It is known from Mike Kalmbach's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2423">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-07-whitecon2001-with-detailsd2423/ whitecon2001-with-details], DeckTech (david "rota" fairbanks, 7 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-07-whitecon2001-with-detailsd2423/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' Lumsten
